description: Küstenschutzbauwerke in Schleswig-Holstein (Nordsee, Stand: 2017) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesbetrieb für Küstenschutz, Nationalpark und Meeresschutz Schleswig-Holstein. Coastal protection structures on the North Sea coast of Schleswig-Holstein, such as groans, dykes and dikes, ditches, lungs, pellet or paths. These are data from terrestrial and photogrammetric surveying as well as digitization using digital orthophotos. Coverage: Landesbetrieb für Küstenschutz, Nationalpark und Meeresschutz Schleswig-Holstein. The portal shows the English title as "Coastal protection structures in Schleswig-Holstein (North Sea, Stand: 2017)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Landesbetrieb für Küstenschutz, Nationalpark und Meeresschutz Schleswig-Holstein. Its keywords include North Sea, inspireidentifiziert, Anthropogenic pressures, opendata, Menschliche Aktivitäten, MDI-HA. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
